# Pieter Provoost

> Marine scientist and data engineer; biodiversity informatician at UNESCO's Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC-UNESCO).

Pieter Provoost is the OBIS data manager at the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS), part of UNESCO's IOC. His work focuses on biodiversity informatics, ocean data standards, and open data infrastructure.
